name: B10-0424/2026 – After § 16 – Am 105
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 16a. Strongly condemns the Commission’s decision to terminate the grant agreement preparation process for the European Network Against Racism (ENAR) for the 2026-2028 period under the Citizens, Equality, Rights and Values (CERV) programme, despite ENAR having successfully passed the evaluation stage and its 2025 technical and financial reports having been accepted; stresses that the withdrawal of EU structural funding from Europe’s largest pan-European anti-racism network, bringing together more than 140 civil society organisations, seriously undermines the sustainability of independent anti-racism civil society; calls on the Commission to urgently review and reverse this decision, provide full transparency on the grounds for and proportionality of the measure, and ensure that funding decisions are not influenced by political or institutional pressure but fully respect the independence, diversity and meaningful participation of civil society in EU policymaking;
